name: Dovetail
description: Dovetail is a customer-insights and user-research repository for projects, data, docs, highlights, tags, themes, transcripts, contacts, channels, and research synthesis.
agentUseSummary: Add a least-privilege 30-day API token, then let selected agents verify token identity and read bounded, minimized project metadata. Relay does not expose research contents, people, authors, URLs, search, the evolving read-write MCP, or mutations.

credentialRequirements.label: Dovetail API token
credentialRequirements.helpText: Use a least-privilege personal API token; Dovetail tokens expire after 30 days.

capabilities.label: Read workspace metadata
capabilities.description: Use three pinned GETs for token identity and bounded, minimized project metadata.

allowed.label: Read Dovetail metadata
allowed.description: Verify token identity and read bounded, minimized project metadata without research contents or people.

blocked.label: Change Dovetail
blocked.description: Projects, folders, docs, data, highlights, tags, themes, people, comments, channels, dashboards, agents, and every mutation remain blocked.

blocked.label: Read research content
blocked.description: Search, raw data, docs, insights, highlights, transcripts, comments, contacts, authors, URLs, channels, themes, dashboards, and AI context are blocked.

blocked.label: Call arbitrary APIs
blocked.description: Hosted MCP, arbitrary tools, paths, filters, cursors, methods, request bodies, content exports, and unbounded reads are blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Token identity and bounded minimized project metadata run directly. Research contents, people, hosted MCP, search, arbitrary APIs, and every mutation remain blocked.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway mounts one read tool with three pinned REST metadata operations through the encrypted personal API token.

providerSetup.blocker: No customer-owned Dovetail workspace, least-privilege 30-day API token, representative project, or safe fixture is available in this workspace.
providerSetup.nextAction: An authorized workspace member creates a least-privilege personal API token and stores it through Relay Console, then verifies token identity, the two minimized project reads, assignment, scheduled 30-day replacement, disconnect, provider-side revocation, and post-disconnect denial.

evidence.supports: Dovetail documents Bearer API tokens, one-time display, manual revocation, and a 30-day token lifetime.
Dovetail documents its Public API base route, API-token authentication, 22-character resource identifiers, and broad read-write research operations.
The project-list schema documents cursor pagination and project IDs, titles, authors, URLs, dates, deletion state, and folder references, supporting Relay's cap and minimization boundary.
Dovetail documents a hosted MCP supporting API-token or OAuth authentication and workspace research tools; the current read-write MCP surface is excluded from Relay's fixed REST contract.
